headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 29, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 12.37%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 8.47%. This results in an average alpha of 3.89%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 44.07%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 6.40%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's relative strength. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
